entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I hope you can help. I need to return something and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing. I've been a VeloFit customer for years.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed, and I really appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Michael Chen, order number is VF88-12-90-C. It's about the ClubFit jersey I ordered.
Thank you, Michael. I have your order pulled up. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's the sizing. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I was so excited for it, but I can barely move. I was hoping to do a return, I just... I really needed this money for something else this month.
Oh, I completely understand how frustrating it is when the fit isn't right. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see you ordered this 39 days ago... one moment.
I know it's been a little while. I was just hoping something could be done.

Of course. And... great news! The ClubFit jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window to send it back for a full refund. We could also process an exchange if you'd prefer.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried. I'd rather just get the refund for now, if that's okay. Is it possible to exchange it later?

Absolutely. We can process the full refund. And Michael, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty and to apologize for the sizing issue with the jersey, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Wow, really? You didn't have to do that. That's so nice. Thank you, Sarah. That actually makes me feel a lot better about this whole thing.

It's my pleasure. We value our long-time customers. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Michael. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
